info.title: Yggdrasil Core API
info.description: Synchronous HTTP surface of yggdrasil-core. Manifest CRUD, integration instances, workflow runs, secrets, GitHub webhook. See docs/api-reference/openapi.md for the narrative companion.

delete.description: Removes every manifest row sharing the (kind, namespace, name) of the supplied version id. Default mode hard-deletes rows; ?soft=true flips active=FALSE while preserving history. Returns 200 with already_absent=true if the id is unknown so periodic purge retries don't trip on transient races. Requires an authorized console session; workflow machine credentials are never accepted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifest version id (the UUID returned by POST/GET)

parameters.name: soft
parameters.description: If true, mark active=FALSE on every version row sharing (kind, namespace, name); otherwise hard-delete those rows.

post.summary: Publish an event into the event stream
post.description: Two-shape endpoint. Generic control-plane events use `type`, `aggregate_type`, `aggregate_id`, `payload` from trusted in-process paths or credential-free local development (an explicit development YGGDRASIL_ENV, ADR-0022). Adapter pods emit INTEGRATION_CONTRACT 6.5 mutation events with `event_type`, `provider`, `resource`, `verb`, `resource_id`, `instance_id`, `idempotency`, `observed`, `emitted_at`, one per successful ensure_*/destroy_*/allowlisted-create_*. Mutation events dedup against `(event_type, idempotency)` within the event_retention_policy TTL: re-posting returns 200 with the original event_id instead of duplicating the row. Hashed machine publishers may submit only mutation events their grants cover. A grant whose instance_id has no `/` is exact and matches the event's instance_id as an opaque string with no database access. A grant `<namespace>/<name>` is logical (ADR-0021): it matches only after Core resolves the event's instance_id (the canonical UUID of any not-yet-purged version, or a literal `<namespace>/<name>`, never a bare name) to an integration_instance with an active version whose active integration_type provider equals the event provider. The server stamps `yggdrasil.io/publisher_grant_form` and, for a logical grant, `yggdrasil.io/publisher_instance_namespace`, `_name`, `_manifest_id` and `_version` into the event metadata, and drops any client value under `yggdrasil.io/publisher_`. The explicit time-bounded plaintext bridge is also mutation-only and receives a reserved server-authored actor. Human console sessions and workflow credentials are never accepted.

200.description: Mutation event deduped (idempotency hit); body carries the original event_id and deduped:true

403.description: event.authorization_denied: the event is generic for a machine or migration credential, or no exact or logical grant of the hashed publisher covers its provider, instance and event type. Not found, not granted and a wrong type provider share one identical body.

503.description: event.authorization_unavailable: a logical grant needed the integration instance lookup and the database did not answer. The detail is fixed; retry later.

post.summary: Prove the effective grant of an event publisher without publishing
post.description: Authenticates an active hashed event-publisher principal, applies the same exact/logical grant decision as POST /api/v1/events and performs no persistence. Legacy migration, workflow and console credentials are rejected. The response excludes bearer material and configured credential digests; grant_set_sha256 covers the complete lexicographically sorted grant set (ADR-0026).

200.description: The authenticated principal holds the queried grant

403.description: event.authorization_denied: the credential is not a hashed principal or the queried tuple is not granted

503.description: event.authorization_unavailable: a logical grant lookup failed

post.description: Resolves the workflow manifest, validates inputs against its schema, and enforces the authenticated machine principal's exact namespace/name allowlist. Machine dispatch must select the current active workflow by namespace/name; manifest_id and explicit version selectors are rejected. It requires spec.authorization and must also pass its RBAC and optional policy. Hashed machine principals are always routed through durable async execution so server-authored ownership and idempotency isolation apply; sync opt-out signals are ignored. Human and time-bounded migration callers may still use sync, which returns the per-step result. Core loads the machine principals and the legacy bridge settings once at start (ADR-0022): a malformed, set-but-blank or cross-scope-colliding inventory answers 401 to every machine request, and a request with no credential is accepted only when nothing is configured and YGGDRASIL_ENV is explicitly dev, development, local or test. Every request the legacy bridge authenticates is logged, counted and audited as workflow_run.legacy_bridge, and its async runs carry yggdrasil.io/creator_legacy_workflow_bridge=true.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Select dispatch mode for human and migration callers. Hashed machine principals are always asynchronous, even when false.

201.description: Synchronous run finished for a human or migration caller

403.description: Machine selector is not current-active namespace/name, workflow is outside the allowlist, lacks required machine authorization, or is denied by manifest authorization

get.description: Machine principals receive only runs created by the same authenticated principal. Foreign and absent run ids both return 404. A poll the legacy bridge authenticates is counted every time and audited as workflow_run.legacy_bridge once per run id per process (ADR-0022).

404.description: Run absent or not owned by this machine principal

post.description: Verifies the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC, looks up the `repository_binding` for `repository.full_name`, applies branch and path filters, and dispatches the bound workflow. Returns 200 with `status: skipped` when no binding is configured (so a webhook on an unmapped repo is harmless). A repository binding cannot dispatch a workflow that declares `spec.authorization` because the webhook carries no authenticated Core actor. While the emergency workflow dispatch lock is enforced, push dispatch returns 503 before binding lookup even when the bound workflow is allowlisted.

501.description: github_actions dispatch is reserved (not implemented in v2.0.0)

503.description: Emergency workflow dispatch lock refuses repository-binding push dispatch

get.summary: Collect a restricted consistent directory snapshot
get.description: Requires directory.snapshot; include_phone also requires directory.contacts.phone. Collect all contiguous pages under one revision and observed_at before replacing a projection. 409 discards the incomplete read. Phone declaration is not verification or messaging consent. See docs/directory-snapshot.md.

data.description: Map of key/value entries; values are not returned by GET

PublishEventRequest.description: Accepts either the generic event shape (type/aggregate_type/aggregate_id/payload) or the INTEGRATION_CONTRACT 6.5 mutation shape (event_type/provider/resource/verb/resource_id/instance_id/idempotency/observed/emitted_at). Presence of event_type selects the mutation branch.

type.description: Generic shape — event type, e.g. infra.alert.firing or manifest.created

payload.description: Generic shape — payload validated against the registered JSON schema

provider.description: Mutation shape — adapter family (e.g. stripe, efi, github)

resource.description: Mutation shape — resource type the adapter manages

verb.description: Mutation shape — past-tense verb; MUST match the verb suffix of event_type

idempotency.description: Mutation shape — dedup key for safe retries

observed.description: Mutation shape — full observed state at emission time

emitted_at.description: Mutation shape — adapter-side timestamp of the mutation

materialized_reactions.description: Number of integration_event_reactions rows fanned out in the same Tx as the event insert

deduped.description: True when the mutation event hit the (event_type, idempotency) unique slot — body carries the original event_id

EventPublishProblem.description: RFC 7807 problem body of the event publish authorization decision

owner_ids.description: Canonical IDs derived only from active typed leadership and inclusive windows at observed_at.

is_lead.description: Explicit typed formal leadership; role and owners input are not authority.

expected_version.description: Operator-only CAS;0 requires no declaration. Conflict preserves the current contact without disclosing it.

TeamLeadershipUpdate.description: Partial team update. Any owners array requires explicit intent and the exact reviewed timestamp; omit owners for an ordinary patch. No membership lifecycle CAS is implied.

owners.description: Explicit canonical identity replacement; empty revokes, null is invalid.
